text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On New Year's Day, while walking around the academy, I noticed a crowd of students gathering.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's finally time for Turbo's
New Year's calligraphy reveal~!
I'm gonna write and write and write this year too, so keep watching~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, um...
Where's the brush—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Right over here. I have also prepared the gaming-spec glowing calligraphy brush and paperweight as requested.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, thanks, Ikuno!
Turbo's gonna put her whole soul into this brushstroke!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's not all.
...A standard sheet of paper would be far too small
to express Turbo-san's passion, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: And so—over there, I've prepared a special giant sheet of paper roughly the size of a 25-meter pool.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: A-Amaaazing...! All right, let's start off with "Above-Board Tactics"! And "Karmic Retribution"! Here I gooo!
choice_data_list: What incredible management skills...!
What incredible management skills...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! And so, let the New Year's Neighborhood Mochi Pounding Festival begin~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
According to my preliminary research, nori mochi was the most popular item last year.
Therefore, this year we've prepared variations with various ingredients sandwiched between the nori and the mochi.
choice_data_list: (Managing things even here...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The fillings were prepared and wrapped by our town's proud
mochi legend—the kimono shop matriarch with over 90 New Years of experience...
Please, enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Swarming Crowd
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, I can't wait! Gimme some mochi alreadyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Ikuno Dictus showcased her overwhelming management skills across numerous events, including the hanetsuki and academy bingo tournaments.

text_block_list.name: Bingo Participants
text_block_list.text:
""...Ah! Yay! I'm on reach!""
""Damn it! If only a 5 would come!""

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The extraordinary feel of being outdoors, speakers placed all around,
calling out numbers to an upbeat tune...
So much care has gone into hyping up the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, to think things could change so much
just from management. ...Maybe I'll study up on this
and share it with everyone at the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Trainer-san.
Thank you for your hard work.
choice_data_list: Look who's talking—you're working hard right from New Year's yourself.
Look at you, working hard right from New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...If you'd like, Trainer,
how about you as well? Wouldn't you like me to
"manage" your New Year's schedule?
choice_data_list: Huh? No...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't hold back.
I shall ensure you spend a flawless New Year...!
choice_data_list: (I-I'm getting manage-mentored!?)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Jokes aside.
Would you like to go visit the shrine together?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Here we are. ...What kind of deity
do you think this shrine is dedicated to?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Management-no-Mikoto... at your service.
choice_data_list: A god like that...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Just kidding. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Although, doing my absolute best in managing things today
is also meant to serve as a declaration of my resolve to God.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To keep running—in order to fulfill that goal,
I wish to acquire even more advanced management capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I dare to push management to its absolute limits and break out of my shell.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: And... I want to show everyone what's possible through management, showing them all its potential.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I should focus on self-management this year too—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If even one more person can feel that way, keep running, and continue chasing their dreams... Then...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...A calendar is meant to "manage" time.
New Year's Day, marking its beginning,
is fitting to renew one's awareness of "management."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "That is why I am clad in special attire—devoting myself to the 'training' and 'enlightenment' of management."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Although, that is not something proven in a single day
—it can only be shown by successfully running through
an entire year without incident.
choice_data_list: I'll lend you a hand with that.
I'll be there to support you with that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I look forward to working with you
again this year.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Writing with the tools you prepared made
Turbo's feelings explode!
Can't I do my New Year's calligraphy in colorful colors!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"The customers were so enthusiastic about eating that all those ingredients we had ran completely out...
C-Can't we do something about this~?!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Rest assured. Everything is within expectations—
allow me to show you my next "measure."
choice_data_list: You truly are... the Deity of Management.
You truly are... the Goddess of Management.
Show me your way of management!
Show me your way of management!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Rest assured. Everything is within expectations—
allow me to show you my next "measure."
choice_data_list: You truly are... the Deity of Management.
You truly are... the Goddess of Management.
Show me your way of management!
Show me your way of management!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"You're a real godsend~!
Not to borrow from Fuku-chan-senpai, but...
Lord Management-no-Mikoto, our savior!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'm far from calling myself a god just yet――
but today, I shall let you pray to me for a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as Ikuno Dictus walked down the stone steps,
her back seemed larger than ever before—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a goddess, you say? I'm honored, but...
I shall accept that title once I have outlasted everyone else on the track.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Here I go—Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Ikuno Dictus dashed
gracefully down the stone steps...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...If I can get through today's management without any issues...
Let's meet again.
choice_data_list: Don't say such ominous things!?
Don't say such ominous things!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm quite alright.
I know my own limits well enough, and—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Because I intend to run all the way through
this year with you as well.
